why: What a test run may remove from the machine's temp directory before it starts, and what it must not.
Two runners read this: the extension's (src_vs_code/scripts/run-tests.mjs) and the server suite's
assembly fixture (src_mcp/tests/TempDirsAreSwept.cs). One rule in one place, because two copies of
it would drift the way the leaked directories did (research/PLAN_the_tests_take_their_temp_directories_with_them.md).
keepMinutes is the operator's ruling of 2026-09-18: clean BEFORE the run, everything older than ten
minutes. Anything a concurrent session is using was touched more recently than that.
neverSwept is what the PRODUCT makes at runtime under the same prefix: a round's answers, its repair
launch, a workspace-less review, an escalation's plan, a Team server job, and a chat's working
directory. A live chat can sit for an hour writing nothing, so its directory is older than any
window a test sweep could use; the product sweeps these itself, on its own clock. A downloaded
server, coai-<version>, is a cache and is never swept either.
